finding.summary: fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX) blocks indefinitely with no timeout. If a process crashes while holding the lock, all other processes will hang forever waiting for the lock.
finding.fix: Add a timeout mechanism using fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB with a retry loop and timeout, or use a library like filelock that supports timeouts.

label: false_positive
label_reason: flock locks are released by the OS when the holder dies (any way, SIGKILL included), so a crashed process cannot leave the lock held; waiting behind a live review is the intended queueing (agent_provider.py docstring).
